newsitem.title: UK: BTR up as report hints big break-up profit.
newsitem.headline: BTR up as report hints big break-up profit.

text.p: Shares in BTR Plc advanced on Thursday following press reports that a break-up of the diversified British conglomerate could yield up to three billion pounds.
The Daily Mail newspaper said on Thursday the most attractive thing about BTR was the break-up value of its complex business spread across the globe.
The stock gained 7-1/2p to 201-1/2 by 0930 GMT in volume of 3.2 million shares.
"The report reminded people that BTR is not that bad at all", one trader said.

BTR was worth about 14 billion pounds, the newspaper said, adding that even a bid with a 30 percent premium on the top of the current market capitalisation of eight billion pounds would return a two to three billion pounds profit.
The stock hit a year's low on June 10 at 180p in the aftermath of a profit warning in May.
